shop.title: Promotions
shop.intro: Reward customers automatically: a coupon or bonus points after their first order, or a code to announce in your live ("LIVE10"). Works on the web shop, chat orders and the POS.
shop.emptyText: Create a first-order reward or a live code to bring customers back.

admin.title: Platform promotions
admin.intro: Campaigns the platform pays for — for example a welcome coupon for everyone who signs up with Facebook or WhatsApp. Shops receive the full price; the platform owes them the discount.
admin.emptyText: Create a sign-up campaign to welcome new customers.
admin.owedIntro: Platform-paid discounts on sales that weren't cancelled.

trigger.signupHint: Everyone who creates an account with the chosen methods gets a coupon.
trigger.first_orderHint: After a customer's first completed order: a coupon for the next one, or bonus points.
trigger.codeHint: Anyone who types the code at checkout — once per customer.

form.name: Name
form.descriptionPh: Shown to customers with their coupon
form.signupHint: Only accounts created with these methods get the coupon.
form.signupAny: No method chosen: every new account gets it.
form.platformPays: The platform pays for these discounts; shops still receive the full price.

loyalty.title: Loyalty points
loyalty.intro: Customers earn points on every completed sale — web, chat orders and the POS — and spend them as a discount. A member is a phone number, so the same customer collects everywhere.
loyalty.earnHint: On what the customer paid for goods, after discounts.
loyalty.example: Spend {spend} → {points} points = {value} off next time ({pct}% back).
loyalty.noMembersText: Customers become members with their first completed sale once points are on.

rewards.title: My rewards
rewards.intro: Coupons you received and your points at each shop.
rewards.noCouponsText: Welcome gifts and thank-you coupons appear here.
rewards.needPhone: Points are saved to your phone number.
rewards.noPoints: No points yet — they come with your first completed order.

box.title: Coupon & points
box.signIn: Sign in to use a coupon or your points.
box.pointsNeedWhatsapp: Points belong to your phone number — connect WhatsApp in your account to use them.
box.signInToUse: Sign in with WhatsApp on this number to use them.

pos.newMember: New member — earns points with this sale
pos.earnHint: This sale earns points for this phone.
